subject: general
question: If ' A + B' means 'A is the daughter of B', 'A - B' means 'A is the father of B', 'A × B' means 'A is the brother of B' and ' A ÷ B' means 'A is the wife of B', then 'P ÷ R - Q × S' will mean:

options.text: Q is the sister of S.
P is the mother of S.
S is the sister of Q.
Q is the daughter of P.

solution:
Family Chart: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cd8ae3409a7e80e7adb6a6adafb5ca1703115230729aa5a03a081d033c62e82.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 ×
 ÷
 -
 
 

 Meaning
 Daughter
 Brother 
 Wife
 Father 
 
 

 

Given: 'P ÷ R - Q × S

It means: P is the wife of R, R is the father of Q and Q is the brother of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d5826f017970da9a3c7c5a499967b24cdafd0a341c835e318b83f5c1b844c03.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb9405db476f5712010bdf52619b917395f0c2b189900660a2f375ea085ec5f0.png] 

So, P is the **mother **of S.

Hence, the correct answer is "Mother".
